title: Fix: Make some of the buttons on the task header accessible to screen readers
body: ### Related Issue **Issue:** #4245 ### Description As a part of the referenced issue, I've added aria-labels to two of the task header buttons: - Close task button: This was read as "icon button" and I was not able to understand what it did for my own. - Delete task button: This was a destructive action, but it also said icon button. I guessed the purpose from the source code. I'm welcome for comments or discussions for this PR or the whole a11y matters. I'm willing to continue on improving Cline's screen reader accessibility as I'm now a daily user of this awesome extension. ### Test Procedure - Existing tests passed - Tested with NVDA so that the buttons were read as I expected - Shouldn't break the appearance since the changes only consist of aria properties ### Type of Change - [x] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue) - [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality) - [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected) - [ ] ♻️ Refactor Changes - [ ] 💅 Cosmetic Changes - [ ] 📚 Documentation update - [ ] 🏃 Workflow Changes ### Pre-flight Checklist - [x ] Changes are limited to a single feature, bugfix or chore (split larger changes into separate PRs) - [x ] Tests are passing (`npm test`) and code is formatted and linted (`npm run format && npm run lint`) - [x] I have created a changeset using `npm run changeset` (required for user-facing changes) - [x] I have reviewed [contributor guidelines](https://github.com/cline/cline/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) ### Screenshots ### Additional Notes ---- > [!IMPORTANT] > Add aria-labels to close and delete task buttons for screen reader accessibility in `TaskHeader.tsx` and `DeleteTaskButton.tsx`. > > - **Accessibility**: > - Add `aria-label="Close task"` to the close task button in `TaskHeader.tsx`. > - Add `aria-label="Delete task"` to the delete task button in `DeleteTaskButton.tsx`. > > This description was created by [](https://www.ellipsis.dev?ref=cline%2Fcline&utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral) for 53a3cd49717bedb19492e7d168f9d8e2ba9f24c6.
